claims.text: Our rights should not be used to take away the rights of fellow citizens.
It is acceptable to disagree with someone's lifestyle.
Rights end where they stop providing a right to tell others how to live.
Trying to restrict their rights makes life tougher for them.

implicit_assumptions: A1: One's civil rights cannot compel another's lifestyle choices.
A2: Any instruction on lifestyle is a restriction of rights.
scope_notes: Applies to individual LGBTQI rights within a democratic society.
